rationale: Proposes a CI workflow and branch rebase to prepare for upstreaming existing fork work; all decisions are in scope and deliverables are independently reversible; actual code landing is explicitly out of scope.

signals.blast_radius: One new CI workflow file for bistec-oss/main; local branch rebase to reconcile 14 commits ahead and 5 commits behind
signals.unresolved: Open questions about external/yomal/ and web/ placement are being decided as part of this proposal, not left unresolved
signals.irreversibility: CI workflow deleted and rebase undone via standard git operations; process artifacts have no persistent effect
